Posted by Adam Dyson on Mar 16th, 2018 // No Comments 
Archford Capital Strategies LLC lessened its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 7.9% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 20,806 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,775 shares during the period. Apple makes up 1.2% of Archford Capital Strategies LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 12th biggest position. Archford Capital Strategies LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,207,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Other hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Valmark Advisers Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 5.4% during the second quarter. Valmark Advisers Inc. now owns 8,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,237,000 after purchasing an additional 438 shares in the last quarter. REDW Stanley Financial Advisors LLC lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 0.8% in the second quarter. REDW Stanley Financial Advisors LLC now owns 15,035 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,165,000 after acquiring an additional 123 shares in the last quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 1,517.7% in the second quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,651,000 after acquiring an additional 167,099 shares in the last quarter. Financial Consulate Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.5% in the second quarter. Financial Consulate Inc. now owns 27,604 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,976,000 after acquiring an additional 675 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Endurance Wealth Management Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.4% in the second quarter. Endurance Wealth Management Inc. now owns 79,511 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $11,451,000 after acquiring an additional 1,850 shares in the last quarter. 61.41% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink . 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. Several research firms recently commented on AAPL. Zacks Investment Research cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Friday, January 19th. Mizuho reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 price target (up previously from $160.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 19th. Barclays set a $174.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Thursday, January 18th. Vetr cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $184.49 price target on the stock. in a research note on Tuesday, February 27th. Finally, Bank of America cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and boosted their price target for the stock from $180.00 to $220.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 17th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $201.57.
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $178.65 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $138.62 and a 52-week high of $183.50. The company has a market capitalization of $906,470.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.48, a PEG ratio of 1.36 and a beta of 1.22. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, February 12th were given a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.41%.
